test_cases.what_to_try: From the learning path, open the Shop with the gem, press the Widget Reward GET STARTED card and read what comes up, press MAYBE LATER and close the Shop; then open the energy page with the lightning bolt, press the Widget Boost INSTALL row and read what comes up, press NOT NOW, and say whether the two were the same thing or two separate things to do.
test_cases.real_if: I can't tell they lead to the same thing, or I come away thinking there are two separate jobs to finish.
test_cases.not_real_if: On seeing what each one opens, I recognise straight away that both are asking me to add the same widget.
test_cases.what_happened: Shop GET STARTED opened a full page: 'Add the Duolingo widget to your home screen to earn an XP Boost.' with a picture of a dark red widget showing a flame and 100 and a green owl, and buttons ADD NOW / MAYBE LATER. I pressed MAYBE LATER, went back to the Shop, and the NEW badge on that card was gone. Energy page INSTALL opened a different-looking page: 'Add the widget to get +8 energy every hour!' with a pink/purple widget showing a flame and 8 and a brown owl with lightning eyes, and buttons ADD WIDGET / NOT NOW. I pressed NOT NOW and the Widget Boost row still had its NEW badge, even though I'd just dismissed the Shop one. Two different pictures of the widget, two different rewards, two different button words, and dismissing one didn't touch the other - I honestly came away thinking these are two different widgets, two separate jobs. Nothing on either page told me they were the same thing. I couldn't have known before pressing, and pressing made me more unsure, not less.
